surface.product: Vista Cloud Digital Platform, Omni-Channel API (OCAPI)

behaviour.summary: The documentation instructs a client to re-fetch an order immediately before cancelling it, because the expiry may have been extended by a separate tab or window. The order's deadline is shared mutable state across every session holding the order identifier, and it is not scoped to the caller who created it.
behaviour.testable_as: Two callers holding one order identifier: a mutation by the second moves the deadline observed by the first, and no member of the first caller's read discloses that another party did it.
behaviour.consequence_for_agents: An agent cannot distinguish its own lease from a lease something else is renewing on its behalf, which makes both release and hand-off unsafe to reason about. CHANGEOVER binds a Hold to one principal and makes hand-off single-consumption, so the deadline is never moved by an unseen third party.

half_life_basis: Published guidance on a maintained page describing a structural property of order-scoped reservation. Half a year.

citation.quote: Before making the cancel request, the client should fetch the order one last time to ensure its expiry hasn't been extended by a separate tab or window.
